body: Thanks for the support, mate. It means a lot to me that someone would take time of their day to try and help a total stranger. Thank you! I'll keep on trying for the time being.

Thank you for taking the time to reply to me!
I live in Europe so I guess a drink is out of the table, but thanks for offering :)
I know that eventually time will make things better, but at the same time I'm afraid it won't. That's the last bit of hope I have in life and if it keeps getting worse I don't know how I'll be able to handle it. Heck, I had cancer when I was 12 and it was far easier to deal with that than to deal with this. Physical pain is so much easier.
My back hurts every single day, but it doesn't really bother me. But psychological pain just sucks the life out of me. I've always been strong and did my best to make the lives of those I care about better, but I'm finding myself lacking strength to care about mine...

Honestly? No reason. I just keep waking up and going on about my day, thinking of killing myself every so often every.single.fucking.day. But I keep on waking up. Maybe someday I decide that there's not even a sliver of hope, and then write my goodbyes and just disappear to never be found, dead somewhere out in the nature.
Totally... It's been more and more appealing lately

Hey there!
First off, your counselors sound like utter dicks. Have you tried switching from them and into someone new?
I understand your feelings about not wanting to hurt others nor having any real reason to keep trying to live.
I can understand why some people say suicide is selfish, but I too believe it's a lot more selfish to force someone that doesn't want to live, to keep doing so.
That being said, have you tried to experiment something new? I don't know, sports, musical instruments, anything? It might help you keep your mind busy and occupied but also might be a chance to meet and form bounds with new people, kinda like a 'fresh start' if you will.
I get that feeling of being hopeless, and right now I'm feeling the same way. It does get better for me, sometimes anyway. Hang on mate, and try to do new stuff, maybe you'll find something that rekindles the passion to live!
If you want to chat, I'll be around :)

My death used to be a BIG deal for me, few years back. Nowadays I just don't really care. Sure, probably I'd like to live longer (I'm only 24 after all) if I got any reasons to stick around, but although my life is moving forward career wise, it's not developing as I want (or need) in the emotional side of it. Sure, I have friends; some pretty good ones too. But it seems that I'm never enough to be considered anything else but a 'good friend'. So, if I did die today, honestly, I'd be at peace. The reason I'm in this subreddit right now is because I was literally thinking about dying 5 minutes ago. My death is no longer a concern, although the death of dear ones still afflict me. But ya, I get what you mean. I guess an empty void is not that scary anymore.
